exposure: history of polycystic ovary syndrome or ovulatory disorders
cohort: 18,939 pregnancies conceived with ART in Massachusetts between 2011 and 2017
finding: Advanced maternal age, endometriosis, and controlled ovarian hyperstimulation were associated with placenta previa in pregnancies conceived with ART, while multiple births and history of polycystic ovary syndrome or ovulatory disorders were negatively associated.
